segments.text: proposition 1 POlygamie is to be auoided: for both it bringeth manie diſcommodities; and the ciuill lawes which be receiued, and honeſtie it ſelfe dooth forbid the ſame.
proposition 2 He that hath not the gift of God to conteine, muſt not vnder the pretenſe of pouertie delaie marriage.

proposition 3 By the forceable power of the imagination which changeth the bodie, and the fruit ioined therevnto, we may conclude of the great power of faith, which changeth the whole bodie, while it dooth effectuallie take hold of Chriſt.
